# World commands

## brp world spawn-entity

Spawn a new Bevy entity with the given components

```text
Spawn a new Bevy entity with the given components

Usage: bevy_copilot brp world spawn-entity [OPTIONS] --components <COMPONENTS>

Options:
      --components <COMPONENTS>  Map of component type path to initial value, e.g. `{"my_game::Health": {"value": 100.0}}`
      --host <HOST>              Host of the BRP HTTP endpoint (env BEVY_BRP_HOST, default 127.0.0.1)
      --port <PORT>              Port of the BRP HTTP endpoint (env BEVY_BRP_PORT, default 15702)
      --compact <COMPACT>        Compact (single-line) JSON output instead of pretty: true|false [possible values: true, false]
  -h, --help                     Print help
```

MCP peer: `brp_spawn_entity`

## brp world get-components

Fetch specific components of an entity by type path

```text
Fetch specific components of an entity by type path

Usage: bevy_copilot brp world get-components [OPTIONS] <ENTITY>

Arguments:
  <ENTITY>  Entity ID to inspect

Options:
      --components <COMPONENTS>  Component type paths to fetch
      --host <HOST>              Host of the BRP HTTP endpoint (env BEVY_BRP_HOST, default 127.0.0.1)
      --port <PORT>              Port of the BRP HTTP endpoint (env BEVY_BRP_PORT, default 15702)
      --strict <STRICT>          Fail when a requested component is missing: true|false (default: tolerate) [possible values: true, false]
      --compact <COMPACT>        Compact (single-line) JSON output instead of pretty: true|false [possible values: true, false]
  -h, --help                     Print help
```

MCP peer: `brp_get_components`

## brp world query

Query entities by component selection and optional filter

```text
Query entities by component selection and optional filter

Usage: bevy_copilot brp world query [OPTIONS] --data <DATA>

Options:
      --data <DATA>        Component selection passed through to world.query, e.g. `{"components": ["my_game::Health"], "option": ["my_game::Mana"]}`
      --host <HOST>        Host of the BRP HTTP endpoint (env BEVY_BRP_HOST, default 127.0.0.1)
      --filter <FILTER>    Optional world.query filter, e.g. `{"with": [...], "without": [...]}`
      --port <PORT>        Port of the BRP HTTP endpoint (env BEVY_BRP_PORT, default 15702)
      --compact <COMPACT>  Compact (single-line) JSON output instead of pretty: true|false [possible values: true, false]
      --strict <STRICT>    Report invalid component types/reflection failures: true|false (default: tolerate); required components still filter entities [possible values: true, false]
  -h, --help               Print help
```

MCP peer: `brp_query`

## brp world mutate-components

Mutate a single field of one component on an entity

```text
Mutate a single field of one component on an entity

Usage: bevy_copilot brp world mutate-components [OPTIONS] --component <COMPONENT> --path <PATH> --value <VALUE> <ENTITY>

Arguments:
  <ENTITY>  Entity ID to modify

Options:
      --component <COMPONENT>  Component type path to mutate
      --host <HOST>            Host of the BRP HTTP endpoint (env BEVY_BRP_HOST, default 127.0.0.1)
      --path <PATH>            Bevy reflection path: fields (`translation.x`), tuple indices, `[array indices]`, or an empty path for the whole component
      --port <PORT>            Port of the BRP HTTP endpoint (env BEVY_BRP_PORT, default 15702)
      --compact <COMPACT>      Compact (single-line) JSON output instead of pretty: true|false [possible values: true, false]
      --value <VALUE>          New value for the field (any JSON)
  -h, --help                   Print help
```

MCP peer: `brp_mutate_components`
